claims.evidence: No automation indicators (sensors, PLC labeling, cycle counters) are visible; control panel is seen but automatic operation cannot be confirmed from a static photo.
Photo 0 shows a blue industrial machine consistent with a blow molding/plastic forming machine, matching witness identification.

claims.claim: Used in production to make PET plastic bottles of different sizes
claims.evidence: No molds, bottle samples, or size-change tooling are visible in the photo; production history and mold variety cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Brand, model and specification plate are not legible, so capacity, voltage, and exact spec are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/spec plate on the machine body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded/unknown-spec unit, worst case for parts and resale value.

risks.risk: Working condition unverified — no power-on or cycle-run evidence.
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powering on and completing a molding cycle.

risks.risk: Completeness of molds, accessories, and tooling for 'different sizes' bottles is unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of all molds, hoppers, and accessories included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the base machine with no extra molds included.

risks.risk: Electrical requirements (voltage/phase) and wiring condition not shown, open cabinet may indicate missing or damaged components.
risks.proof: Photo of wiring/control board inside the open cabinet and a label showing voltage/phase.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming wiring needs inspection/repair before use.

risks.risk: Age, usage hours, and maintenance history unknown; heavy wear could reduce lifespan.
risks.proof: Maintenance logbook photo or hour-meter reading if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used with unknown remaining service life.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the nameplate/specification plate (brand, model, voltage, capacity).
Video of the machine powering on and running a full molding cycle.
Photos of all molds and accessories included in the sale.
Close-up of internal wiring and control board condition.
Any maintenance records or hour-meter reading.
response.reason: The witness reliably identifies the item as a plastic blow molding machine, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified brand, working condition, and completeness) pending the listed proofs.
